The Warden,
[Hostel Name],
[Institution Name],
[City]

Subject: Report of students leaving the hostel without permission

Respected Sir/Madam,

This is to bring to your kind notice that seven students left the hostel on Monday without obtaining prior permission. I am submitting this report for your information and necessary action.

Yours faithfully,

[Your Name]
[Your Designation]
